Familiar translates proven human medicines into novel therapeutics for the animals who share our lives, designed to reach every pet, through every veterinary clinic. See our pipeline Contact us The opportunity Our pets get the same diseases we do. They deserve the same breakthroughs. Dogs and cats develop many of the same cancers, immune disorders, and other serious diseases that affect people, but the medicines available to treat them haven’t kept pace. For families and veterinarians, that means facing devastating diagnoses with too few options. We believe pets deserve medicines that can change the course of disease. Familiar exists to help make that possible. Our approach Built on human science. Developed for pets. Familiar takes proven human drug candidates with validated targets and established safety data, and translates them into novel therapeutics for companion animals.
